name: Lakeshire Inn
summary: At Lakeshire Inn, travelers and townsfolk seek shelter as danger closes around Lakeshire. On Lake Everstill, the inn offers food, drink, and a place to hear news amid the town’s troubles.

sections.title: A Beacon of Warmth
sections.body: On the shore of Lake Everstill, Lakeshire Inn offers a short rest from the gnoll bands and Blackrock orcs pressing against the town. Though Lakeshire’s military position grows more desperate, the tavern remains warm and welcoming. Barkeep Daniels and Innkeeper Brianna serve ale, wine, and hot meals to locals and travelers. Townspeople gather to trade news, ease their sorrows, and seek hired blades to defend the kingdom’s eastern border.

sections.title: Patrons and Whispers
sections.body: Wiley the Black watches the room from a table, keeping his thoughts to himself and an eye on dangers in the region. Traveling brewers such as Yorus Barleybrew stop at the inn, and Darcy Parker and other townsfolk visit the common room. For those bound for the jagged peaks or south toward Duskwood, Lakeshire Inn is the last safe haven before the contested wilderness.

faq.q: What services does the Lakeshire Inn provide?
aliases: what can I do at lakeshire inn
faq.answer: Innkeeper Brianna binds hearthstones and rents rooms, while Barkeep Daniels provides food, drink, and refreshments for the road.

faq.q: Why is the inn so crowded despite the nearby attacks?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs descend from the northern crags, and gnolls raid local farms, driving townspeople and displaced settlers toward safety in the town center. The tavern offers shelter and a place to share news of the defense.

Wiley the Black is a human rogue who keeps to himself inside the inn. Gryan Stoutmantle of Westfall once saved his life, and Wiley repays him by sharing what he knows about the Defias Brotherhood with adventurers Gryan sends his way.

faq.q: Where is the inn located within Lakeshire?
faq.answer: The inn sits near Lakeshire’s western entrance, on the northern bank of Lake Everstill and just off the main road from Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can use Lakeshire Inn as a base while helping defend Stormwind’s vulnerable eastern flank.
You can find cooking staples, local recipes, and fresh drink from Barkeep Daniels in the common room.
